provenance.composition: Initial runs began during integration. Failures affected by intermediate sources or wall/VM timeouts were repeated; final-guards also replaces the packshot receipt. Every receipt is retained, with final effective comparison separate.
provenance.offline_preload: blocks env file reads and HTTP/TCP/TLS/fetch; no production credentials loaded
provenance.immutable_git_cache: only git show with a fixed hexadecimal blob revision, args+cwd+encoding keyed; fresh Buffer copy; HEAD/log/diff/errors/worktree reads never cached
provenance.compiled_test_cache: candidate caches transpiled code only by filename+exact transformed text; source still read and fresh VM/exports on every world
provenance.raw_logs: retained locally under .claude/amostra-proof in each isolated worktree; hashes for final guards included
provenance.pglite: 0.5.11 embedded Postgres; queues statements, does not claim independent live-connection concurrency
